sources.author: Petal Maps Non-Huawei
patch_list: Forces AccountPickerSignInHubPresenter to always use the WebView H5 login path, bypassing HMS Core availability checks that fail on non-Huawei devices.
Neutralizes the native integrity check (SecurityDetect.irpj) that kills the process upon detecting APK re-signing.

Changes the package name from com.huawei.maps.app to morphe.huawei.petal.maps by default, allowing the patched app to coexist with the original. Changing the package name can lead to unexpected issues.
Forces HMS Core sign-in path (a.g) in AccountFactory. Requires HMS Core installed. Disable if HMS Core is not available.
Changes PetalMapsActivity's screenOrientation from "behind" to "unspecified", allowing the app to rotate freely.
Forces the Huawei manufacturer check to always return true, allowing non-Huawei devices to use the app.
